description: Finder integration: get the path of the frontmost Finder window, get the current Finder selection, reveal a file or folder in Finder, open a path with a specific app, or move a path to the Trash (recoverable — goes to Trash, not rm). reveal and open_with need no special permissions; frontmost_path, get_selection, and trash script Finder and require Automation > Finder permission. trash moves files to Trash and never falls back to permanent deletion.

action.description: frontmost_path — path of the Finder window in focus; get_selection — selected items; reveal — show path in Finder; open_with — open path using a named app; trash — move path to Trash.

app_name.description: Application name for open_with, e.g. "TextEdit". Omit to use the default app for the file.

path.description: Absolute path for reveal, open_with, and trash actions.

name: macos_manage_finder

count.description: Number of selected items. Present for action=get_selection.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `finder_not_open`: frontmost_path or get_selection called but Finder has no open window. `path_not_found`: The provided path is not absolute or does not exist on disk. `app_not_found`: open_with names an app_name that no installed application matches. `trash_refused`: Finder refuses to move an existing path to the Trash — the item is locked, in use, or on a volume without a Trash. `accessibility_required`: get_selection, frontmost_path, or trash is denied Automation > Finder permission. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

path.description: POSIX path of the frontmost Finder window, or null when no window is open. Present for frontmost_path and write actions.

paths.description: POSIX paths of selected items in Finder. Present for action=get_selection.

items.description: POSIX path of a selected item.

success.description: True when the operation completed. Present for write actions.

title: Manage macOS Finder
